name: Chisa

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0 Whimpering Wastes (Support/Negative Status)

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Broadblade Support dedicated to Negative-Status teams. Applies 'Unseen Snare' -> Havoc Bane (DEF Shred) on marked targets; grants Negative-Status appliers/dealers 18% DEF Ignore (Thread of Bane) and, via Outro, +3 max Negative Status stacks. Forte 'Ring of Chainsaw' unlocks a Chainsaw Basic Attack combo ending in the shielding nuke 'Sawring - Eradication'.

skills.normalAttack: Reign of Silence - 2-hit chain into Rending Lunge/Death Snip/Thread Withdrawn combo string; Chainsaw Mode swaps this for Sawring - Blitz.
skills.resonanceSkill: Fractured Composition - Eye of Unraveling (base) / Serrated Loop (enhanced, at full Forte, enters Chainsaw Mode).
skills.forte: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion - governs Unseen Snare/Havoc Bane application and Chainsaw Mode's Sawring-Blitz/Eradication combo (team shield on cast).
skills.liberation: Moment of Nihility - Havoc DMG + team heal, enters Woven Myriad - Convergence (buffs Chainsaw attacks +120% multiplier).
skills.outro: Unraveling - Law Zero - grants team +3 max Negative Status/Electro Rage stacks and Thread of Bane on Negative-Status hits, for 20s.

bestWeapons: Kumokiri (signature, 100%, +24% DMG Bonus to Negative Status appliers)
Meditations on Mercy (69%, best F2P craftable)
echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best overall, team ATK buff)
Thread of Severed Fate (best for personal damage)

teams.name: Best Team (Negative Status)
teams.notes: Only worth using in dedicated Negative-Status teams (her buffs require the DPS to self-apply Negative Status); outclassed by free options as a generalist support.

rotation: Opener: Basic 1-2 -> Skill (Eye of Unraveling) -> Rending Lunge -> Death Snip -> Thread Withdrawn -> Ultimate -> Basic 2 -> Skill (Serrated Loop, Chainsaw Mode) -> Sawring Blitz 2-3 -> Eradication (swap) -> Outro. Loop rotation replaces the opener basics with Intro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier (T0/T0) Support specifically for Negative Status team archetypes (Glacio Chafe, Fusion Burst, Aero Erosion, Spectro Frazzle) with strong healing/shielding/grouping; near useless outside Negative Status teams since almost all her buffs are conditional on the recipient applying their own Negative Status. Weaker in multi-wave Whimpering Wastes since Havoc Bane needs time to ramp.
